about_meta_title: About LAJU | A Quiet Space for Genuine Conversations
about_meta_desc: Why we built LAJU: a manifesto for calm messaging, uncompromising privacy, and open source freedom.
about_hero_title: A Quiet Space for Genuine Conversations
about_hero_lead: In an increasingly noisy and distracted world, conversations with the people closest to you should be a place of rest — not an arena for attention extraction.
about_photo_caption: Tranquility is not an afterthought, but a fundamental human right in communication.
about_section1_title: The Noise We Normalized for Too Long
about_section1_p1: Modern messaging apps have morphed into relentless attention machines. Endless notifications, anxiety-inducing status indicators, recommendation algorithms, and surreptitious personal data harvesting. We communicate more than ever, yet feel more exhausted and surveilled.
about_section1_p2: We believe private conversations should never resemble social media feeds. Your words are not commodities to sell to advertisers, and your peace of mind is too valuable to be bartered for engagement metrics.
about_section2_title: Returning to the Essence of Connection
about_section2_p1: LAJU was born from a simple longing: a messenger that is quiet, lightweight, and genuinely respectful of personal boundaries. A place to share moments with family, exchange thoughts with friends, or collaborate with close peers without unnecessary friction.
about_section2_p2: An application that is there when you need it, and lets you breathe when you want to step away.
about_principles_sub: The foundational principles guiding every line of code and design decision at LAJU.
about_principle1_desc: End-to-end encryption is not a marketing checkbox. At LAJU, we never demand your phone number or email to register, never upload your address book, and our servers are mathematically incapable of reading your messages. Cryptographic sovereignty remains in your hands.
about_principle2_desc: We reject psychological tricks designed to keep you glued to your screen. Zero ads, zero third-party tracking SDKs, and zero artificial urgency. A clean, focused interface built so you can say what you need to say and return to real life.
about_principle3_desc: Trust is earned through transparency, not corporate promises. The entire LAJU codebase is open for independent audits, research, and self-hosting under AGPLv3. We believe essential communication infrastructure belongs in the open, not locked in proprietary black boxes.
about_open_source_closing: LAJU is released as free software under the GNU AGPLv3 license. Our source code is entirely open on GitHub for anyone who cares about the future of digital freedom.
about_github_link_text: Explore the Source Code on GitHub

help_articles_sub: Last updated: 2026 • Official LAJU application guide
help_faq1_title: 1. How do I register an account on LAJU?
help_faq1_desc: Registration in LAJU requires zero personal identifiable information (No PII). No phone numbers, SMS codes, or email addresses needed. Just download the app, choose a unique Username, store your backup PIN, and your cryptographic keypair is generated directly on your device.
help_faq1_tip: Keep your Username and 6-digit backup PIN safe. These credentials are the only way to restore your encrypted backup on a new device.
help_faq2_title: 2. What happens if I forget my backup PIN?
help_faq2_desc: Because LAJU uses a Zero-Knowledge architecture, our servers never store your PIN. If you still have access to your device, you can update your PIN in Settings > Security. If the app is uninstalled and the PIN is lost, previous message history cannot be decrypted.
help_faq3_title: 3. Why are my messages sometimes delayed or pending?
help_faq3_desc: End-to-end encrypted messages deliver via relay nodes. If a message is delayed, ensure the recipient is connected to the internet and review Android battery optimization settings to allow background delivery.
help_faq4_title: 4. How do P2P voice and video calls work?
help_faq4_desc: Calls in LAJU use direct WebRTC Peer-to-Peer encrypted connections. Media streams directly between callers without intermediary media servers, providing crystal-clear quality and data savings.
help_faq5_title: 5. How to submit a problem ticket?
help_faq5_desc: To report bugs or issues, open Settings > Help in the LAJU app and select Submit Ticket. You can also email support@laju.chat with your app version and issue description.
help_contact_box_desc: Send inquiries, security disclosures, or collaboration proposals to our team:
privacy_meta_desc: Official privacy policy of LAJU Messenger. Your privacy and end-to-end data encryption are our absolute priority.
privacy_hero_desc: We built LAJU from the ground up on zero-knowledge foundations: what you discuss, who you contact, and what you share belongs exclusively to you. We hold no keys to inspect your conversations.
privacy_pillars_title: 4 Pillars of Data Protection in LAJU
privacy_pillars_sub: How we guarantee your conversations remain exclusively yours.
privacy_pillar1_desc: Every text, photo, video, and file is encrypted on the sender's device and can only be decrypted by the recipient's device.
privacy_pillar2_desc: Your private keys are safely stored locally on your device. Our servers never hold keys to decipher your message contents.
privacy_pillar3_desc: 100% free of third-party advertising tracking SDKs (such as AdMob or Meta). We never sell your personal profile to anyone.
privacy_pillar4_desc: Messages are stored encrypted for multi-device synchronization. Disappearing messages auto-wipe history, and accounts can be instantly purged from servers.
privacy_articles_sub: Last updated: October 2026 • Legally binding for all LAJU users
privacy_sec1_title: 1. 100% Anonymous Registration (No Phone Number or Email)
privacy_sec1_lead: LAJU is engineered on radical privacy principles: we never ask for, collect, or store any personal identifiable information (Zero PII).
privacy_sec1_p1_desc: No SMS, no cellular OTP codes. Your phone number is never requested or logged.
privacy_sec1_p2_desc: You never have to register, link, or verify an email address.
privacy_sec1_p3_desc: We never ask for real names, ID/passports, biometric data, or birthdays.
privacy_sec1_p4_desc: Accounts operate purely through public-private keypairs (Ed25519 & X25519) on your device.
privacy_sec2_title: 2. Data We Strictly Never Store in Plaintext
privacy_sec2_item1_desc: Text, files, voice recordings, and media never exist in plaintext on our servers. Everything is encrypted before transmission.
privacy_sec2_item2_desc: We never upload, sync, or copy your phonebook. Adding contacts is done voluntarily via Username or QR code.
privacy_sec2_item3_desc: We do not conduct hidden background location tracking. Location permissions are only accessed when you voluntarily use the Share Location feature.
privacy_sec2_item4_desc: Voice and video calls stream directly peer-to-peer using encrypted WebRTC. Servers only facilitate initial signaling handshakes.
privacy_sec3_desc: Messages and media are transmitted encrypted. Relay servers store encrypted payloads to facilitate multi-device chat history synchronization and delivery when recipients are temporarily offline. You retain full control via message recall (delete for everyone), disappearing message timers, and chat wiping.
privacy_sec4_desc: Privacy sovereignty is yours. Whenever you decide to stop using LAJU, use the Delete Account option in Settings. This permanently purges your public profile, sessions, keys, and group memberships from server databases with no recovery option.
privacy_sec5_desc: If you have technical questions, security disclosures, or privacy audits regarding LAJU, contact our official security mailbox:
terms_meta_title: Terms of Service | LAJU Secure Messenger
terms_meta_desc: Official terms of service of LAJU Messenger. Safe, fair, transparent, and identity-free communication.
terms_hero_desc: LAJU provides encrypted messaging and calling infrastructure without requiring phone numbers or email addresses. These terms are straightforward and fair to safeguard communication freedom while protecting the ecosystem from exploitation.
terms_card_desc: We do not monetize users, deploy manipulative curation algorithms, or partner with data brokers. You retain absolute control over your cryptographic identity.
terms_pillars_title: 4 Pillars of LAJU Terms of Service
terms_pillars_sub: Principles of fairness and transparency binding both developers and all users.
terms_pillar1_desc: You do not need to provide phone numbers, email addresses, or national IDs. Your cryptographic key is your account.
terms_pillar2_desc: You are the sole owner of all conversations and media you transmit. We claim zero intellectual property over your communications.
terms_pillar3_desc: The platform is strictly prohibited for financial fraud, hacking, malware distribution, bulk automated spam bots, or physical crime.
terms_pillar4_desc: You hold the unconditional right to delete your account anytime. All public keys and active sessions are destroyed immediately from servers.
terms_articles_sub: Last updated: October 2026 • Legally binding for all LAJU users
terms_sec1_body: By downloading, installing, or accessing LAJU, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. LAJU provides high-speed, encrypted instant messaging infrastructure ensuring user confidentiality and sovereignty.
terms_sec2_body: LAJU is designed for autonomous communication without surrendering personal data: no phone numbers, no email addresses, and no official identity credentials (ID/Passport) required. Your account is tied directly to keypairs generated on your device.
terms_sec3_body: Because LAJU implements Zero-Knowledge architecture, our servers never store copies of your private keys or security PIN. You bear sole responsibility for safeguarding your device, PIN, and identity backups. Developers have no backdoor to restore lost access keys.
terms_sec4_body: To preserve network integrity, you agree NOT to use LAJU for unsolicited spam, rogue automation overwhelming relays, malware distribution, fraud, or abusive exploitation. Serious violations will trigger cryptographic route revocation by network security defenses.
terms_sec5_body: You retain absolute ownership of all text, media, and attachments you transmit. LAJU never monetizes user data and is completely ad-free. Messages are stored encrypted on relay servers to support multi-device sync and offline delivery. You hold full lifecycle controls including recall (delete for everyone), disappearing timers, and chat wiping.
terms_sec6_body: Relay infrastructure aims for 99.99% SLA availability powered by resilient transactional outboxes. The service is provided 'as is' without absolute guarantees over third-party carrier network disruptions.
terms_sec7_body: You may terminate service at any time at no cost. Simply navigate to Settings > Account > Delete Account in the app to instantly purge all sessions and user records permanently from servers. For questions or technical support, reach out to support@laju.chat.
